title.en: Accrued income and income received in advance
title.kn: ಬರಬೇಕಾದ ಆದಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂಗಡವಾಗಿ ಪಡೆದ ಆದಾಯ

heading.en: Earned but not received, received but not earned

hook.en: A tenant pays three months' rent in advance; a bank credits interest only after the year ends. Profit must show income earned, not just cash received.
hook.kn: ಬಾಡಿಗೆದಾರ ಮೂರು ತಿಂಗಳ ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಂಗಡವಾಗಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ವರ್ಷ ಮುಗಿದ ನಂತರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಆದಾಯ ತೋರಬೇಕು, ಪಡೆದ ನಗದು ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ.

objectives.en: Show both in the final accounts.

narration.en: A tenant pays three months' rent in advance; a bank credits interest only after the year ends. Profit must show income earned, not just cash received.
narration.kn: ಬಾಡಿಗೆದಾರ ಮೂರು ತಿಂಗಳ ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಂಗಡವಾಗಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ವರ್ಷ ಮುಗಿದ ನಂತರ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಜಮಾ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಆದಾಯ ತೋರಬೇಕು, ಪಡೆದ ನಗದು ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ.

body.en: Accrued income is income earned during the year but not yet received, such as interest on investments due but not credited. Entry: Accrued Income A/c Dr To Income A/c. Treatment: add it to the income in the profit and loss account; show it as a current asset.

points.en: Accrued Income A/c Dr To Income A/c

narration.en: Accrued income is income earned during the year but not yet received, such as interest on investments due but not credited. Entry: Accrued Income A/c Dr To Income A/c. Treatment: add it to the income in the profit and loss account; show it as a current asset.
narration.kn: ಬರಬೇಕಾದ ಆದಾಯ ಎಂದರೆ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಗಳಿಸಿದ್ದು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪಡೆಯದ ಆದಾಯ. ಅದನ್ನು ಆದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Income received in advance (unearned income) is received in the current year but relates to the next year. Entry: Income A/c Dr To Income Received in Advance A/c. Treatment: deduct it from the income in the profit and loss account; show it as a current liability.

points.en: Income A/c Dr To Income Received in Advance A/c

narration.en: Income received in advance (unearned income) is received in the current year but relates to the next year. Entry: Income A/c Dr To Income Received in Advance A/c. Treatment: deduct it from the income in the profit and loss account; show it as a current liability.
narration.kn: ಮುಂಗಡವಾಗಿ ಪಡೆದ ಆದಾಯ ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದ್ದು. ಅದನ್ನು ಆದಾಯದಿಂದ ಕಳೆದು ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಯಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Hari & Co. holds 10% investments of ₹50,000 for the whole year; interest received ₹3,000. Rent received ₹18,000 includes ₹4,500 for the next year. Find the amounts for the final accounts.

steps.en: Interest in P&L = 3,000 + 2,000 = ₹5,000; accrued interest ₹2,000 is a current asset.
Rent in P&L = 18,000 − 4,500 = ₹13,500; rent received in advance ₹4,500 is a current liability.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Hari & Co. holds 10% investments of ₹50,000 for the whole year; interest received ₹3,000. Rent received ₹18,000 includes ₹4,500 for the next year. Find the amounts for the final accounts.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of the PUC board and CUET exams.

points.en: Accrued income: add to income; current asset.
points.kn: ಬರಬೇಕಾದ ಆದಾಯ: ಆದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ; ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ.

points.en: Income received in advance: deduct from income; current liability.
points.kn: ಮುಂಗಡ ಆದಾಯ: ಆದಾಯದಿಂದ ಕಳೆಯಿರಿ; ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ.

points.en: Profit shows income earned in the year, not cash received.
points.kn: ಲಾಭವು ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಪಡೆದ ನಗದನ್ನಲ್ಲ.

homework.en: Make a four-row table: outstanding expense, prepaid expense, accrued income, advance income — with the P&L and balance sheet treatment of each.

narration.en: Recap. Accrued income: add to income; current asset. Income received in advance: deduct from income; current liability. Profit shows income earned in the year, not cash received.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬರಬೇಕಾದ ಆದಾಯ: ಆದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ; ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ. ಮುಂಗಡ ಆದಾಯ: ಆದಾಯದಿಂದ ಕಳೆಯಿರಿ; ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ. ಲಾಭವು ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಪಡೆದ ನಗದನ್ನಲ್ಲ.
